# source: array manual §1-2 — colspec letters are read at the tabular; the
# >{...} pre and <{...} post modifiers select a wrapping column's alignment
# (\raggedright, \raggedleft, \centering) and leave an l, c or r column on
# its letter's side, as lualatex does; \arraybackslash is inert, and an
# unmodelled effect is named once (W0104); \newcolumntype is not read.
pre refuse:W0301 \newcolumntype{Y}{c}
body refuse:W0104 \begin{tabular}{>{\bfseries}c}a\end{tabular}
body impl \begin{tabular}{>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{3cm}}Cell content.\end{tabular}
body impl \begin{tabular}{>{\centering}c}Cell content.\end{tabular}
body impl \begin{tabular}{>{\raggedleft}l}Cell content.\end{tabular}
body impl \begin{tabular}{c<{\arraybackslash}}Cell content.\end{tabular}
pre impl \setlength{\extrarowheight}{2pt}
